items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: I don't know, I might go with the Buzzards next year if Harold don't have nothing.

ctx.x: Oh, I've been with the Buzzards for years. They tried to get me to go back now. I don't know, I might go with the Buzzards next year if Harold don't have nothing. I ain't going to be there.
He ain't going to be there?
